notes: • Money Scripts: fixes from a first-user walkthrough — an example fund to try in Portfolios, a clear warning before the demo replaces your build (Undo stays available), the "Changed since you tested it" note and Test again now sit on the Run step, clearer walkthrough wording, and the demo's Next button is now "Next step".

• Money Scripts: try the small-edges demo (an example build you can step through, read-only, never touching your own); three ways in on the Small edges page: add a block, start from a playbook, check your strategy; a "Published record" card for the Cornell paper (no figures shown, they could not be checked); a note on Renaissance's filings page that they are quarter-end holdings, not its trading.

• Money Scripts: new Small edges page in Ideas with research sources for reversal, regime, residual mean reversion and pairs; "Changed since you tested it" check with a Test again button on Run; short walkthrough stories at the top of Learn (and a "How do I…?" link on Home); an Idea Lab "chance of a fluke" label.

• Money Scripts: new "What do you want to do?" search row on Home (type a plain name like add a stop or copy to TradingView and jump straight to it); More options now sits above the Next button; the Test step has a single forward button; Orders step renamed Entries and exits
• Step-by-step Money Scripts: numbered doors 1 Ideas, 2 Build, 3 Test, 4 Run; one question per screen with More options; Ideas and AI Lab names.

• Pine Composer: the AI strategy studio. Under Build → Recipes & prompt, describe a new script or a change to the one you have, or start from any built-in strategy or scenario. You see what would change (layers added, removed or changed) before you tap Apply, and Revert undoes it. Every answer is checked against TradingView limits. Connect AI adds your own key or forge server once on this device. Educational, not investment advice.
• Pine Composer: new "Where it runs" page (Build and Learn) shows which parts run in the app, in TradingView, or only on your forge, and the data each one needs.

• Ideas: any page can now have a place. Tap "Set place…" under a page to name it and drop a pin on the map; the new Map tab shows every page that has a pin, and tapping one opens it. Pages without a place are untouched.

• Ideas: any page can now be a to-do, appointment or event. Tap "Schedule…" under a page to give it a date (and a time if you like); the new Calendar tab shows your month with each day's list, and to-dos tick off right there. Capturing an idea works exactly as before.

• Ideas: a page's Bubbles board can now go to Obsidian or any canvas app. In the vault popup, "Export this page's bubbles (.canvas)" saves your bubbles, their positions, colours and lines as an open .canvas file. The freehand diagram is not included.

• Ideas: take your pages to Obsidian or any Markdown notes app. The new vault button exports every page as a .md file (links, homes and extra places kept) in one zip, and imports .md files or a zipped vault back. Importing never deletes anything: pages with the same title are matched, your own writing is kept unless you choose to replace it, and one Undo reverts the whole import.
